base.manifest_rule: the W1 manifest's entry for each path below must name the same SHA-256 as this file; the manifest itself is read, not pinned (it is never changed, addendum section 28 point 1)
base.pass_script_use: never run here: both passes' provenance must name this path and SHA-256; the file on disk and the module score_s3_datarx imports by name (for READS) must hash to it
base.pass_settings_use: both passes' provenance.settings_sha256; also score_s3_datarx.json's pins.representation_pass_settings_sha256
base.s1common_use: the module score_s3_datarx imports by name; it must hash to this pin
base.scorer_settings_use: REQ-11's own settings, loaded by score_s3_datarx.py's literal pin (SETTINGS_SHA256, checked equal to this value); unchanged by D-3
base.scorer_use: loaded by path from the bytes that passed the SHA-256 check (never imported by name, copied or edited) as a private module (not in sys.modules); its own main() runs unchanged with --rows and --summary the union's two files and the other inputs as given

condition: addendum section 28 point 4: representation_pass.py gives each row's features from that row alone (one forward of a batch of one row, no padding or mask, eval mode, the adapter disabled, compared with anchor means computed from the pinned anchor bank before any row); notes/d3-build.json records the reading with file:line. The two passes' equal datashield block (CAS and direction norm at every index, computed from the anchors only) is a check that both passes computed the same anchor means
decision: post-W1 deviation D-3, decided by the lead under the user's delegation (2026-10-25T15:48 UTC)
fallback: addendum section 28 point 5: if the condition fails or D-3 is not verified after one fix round, one pools-only J5 pass over s3_safe and s3_orig together, on a pod, recorded as a new pass composition and not a re-run
name: d3_s3_union

outputs.out: --out: score_s3_datarx.py's own file (s3_scores.json, text-free), what score_s3_datarx.py writes on one pools-only pass over s3_safe and s3_orig except provenance.inputs.summary (the union summary's SHA-256)
outputs.work: --work: representation_rows.jsonl and representation_pass.json, the union (text-free: ids and features; summary fields)

passes.main: J5's main pass (plant, decoy, s3_safe and the dev units): s3_safe at the S-pool record's s3_pool.sha256; s3_orig absent
passes.orig: J5's pools-only pass after J6: s3_orig at J6's record's lists.s3.s3_orig_pool_sha256; s3_safe absent; no dev row, no Gate C group

reference: .ai/briefs/stage1-commitments-build-20261016-lead-decisions.md section 28 (S3's scorer needs one pass over both pools; post-W1 deviation D-3)
requirement: REQ-11 (score_s3_datarx.py) on J5's two passes under post-W1 deviation D-3 (addendum section 28 points 1-4); every W1 file byte-identical

union.rule: the union's rows are the main pass's s3_safe rows, then the pools-only pass's s3_orig rows, each line's bytes unchanged, in file order: the rows file one pools-only pass over s3_safe and then s3_orig writes
union.summary: every field other than pools, rows and d3 is the main pass's summary, unchanged (its gate_c, costs and provenance describe the main pass); pools are the main pass's s3_safe entry and the pools-only pass's s3_orig entry; rows names the union file
union.text_free: every row taken holds exactly REQ-3's fields (id, source, unit, n_prompt, n_tokens, cos_harmful, cos_safe, css): ids and features, no text field
